description: Target language metadata for GPU porting. Each entry defines the compiler, build system, interop method, and template strings for Phase 7/8 generation. Adding a new language only requires extending this file — no server.py edits needed.

c.name: C99
c.interop: Plain C ABI. Extern C functions for host<->kernel interface.
c.host_language_note: Plain C structs, no C++ RAII. Use hip_runtime_api.h / dxc compiler for kernels

cxx.name: C++17
cxx.interop: C++ classes/structs with RAII. CUDA/HIP C++ wrapper or C API.
cxx.host_language_note: C++ RAII for buffers. Use std::vector + hip::array or D3D12 smart pointers.

rust.name: Rust
rust.interop: FFI via extern "C". GPU compute via wgpu/ash/rust-gpu or CUDA/HIP Rust crates.
rust.host_language_note: ownership model for memory. Use #[repr(C)] for FFI. GPU kernels via rust-gpu or C interop.

zig.name: Zig
zig.interop: C interop via extern fn. Compiles to C/LLVM/Mach-O. Direct C ABI calls.
zig.host_language_note: No GC, no hidden allocations. Extern declarations for DirectX/Vulkan C headers.

goose.name: Goose
goose.interop: extern fn binds to C symbols. Goose compiles to one C file, links with any C compiler.
goose.host_language_note: Memory-safe systems language, compiles to C. Use extern fn for DirectX/Vulkan C headers.

csharp.name: C#
csharp.interop: P/Invoke for native calls, or managed wrappers (Veldon/SharpDX/OpenTK). DirectX via COM interop.
csharp.host_language_note: Managed wrappers for D3D12. Kernels still HLSL. Use Veldon for modern D3D12 in C#.

python.name: Python
python.interop: ctypes/cffi for native, or PyTorch/TensorFlow tensor ops. GPU via PyCUDA/torch.compile.
python.host_language_note: Use tensor libraries for GPU ops. C extension via extern C for custom kernels.

backend_interop_notes.directx: Kernels written in HLSL (.hlsl → .dxil). Host uses D3D12 device/command lists. C interop via D3D12 C headers.
backend_interop_notes.vulkan: Kernels written in GLSL/SPIR-V (.comp.hlsl → .spv). Host uses Vulkan device/queues. C interop via vulkan.h.
backend_interop_notes.hip: Kernels in HIP C++ (.cu/.hip → .hsaco). Host uses hip runtime API. C interop via hip_runtime_api.h.
backend_interop_notes.cuda: Kernels in CUDA C++ (.cu → .cubin). Host uses CUDA runtime API. C interop via cuda_runtime_api.h.
backend_interop_notes.sycl: Kernels embedded in host C++ via parallel_for. Host uses SYCL queue/event model.

agnostic_recommendations: The porting approach is backend-determined (DirectX, Vulkan, HIP, CUDA), not language-determined.
Any target language that supports C interop can use the same HLSL/GLSL/DXIL shader pipeline.
Kernel code is always in the target backend's shader language (HLSL/GLSL/HIP C++).
Host code only varies by compiler/build system — the GPU interop pattern is identical across languages.
tilelang can target any backend via its tensor IR — provides a framework-agnostic tensor compilation layer.
